## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this is the smallest appropriate
change.

## Compatibility impact

- [ ] No public contract change
- [ ] JSON Schema / DTO
- [ ] Rust behavior
- [ ] Native ABI
- [ ] Language bindings
- [ ] Packaging / release artifacts
- [ ] Debug Web / telemetry

Document migrations, version changes, and backward-compatibility evidence for
every checked area.

## Validation

List exact commands, fixtures, consumer tests, and observed results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover success, boundary, and failure behavior.
- [ ] Cross-language fixtures were updated when behavior is shared.
- [ ] Public documentation and examples were updated.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompt data, internal paths, or proprietary
      material are included.
- [ ] Schema, ABI, version, and release metadata remain consistent.
